subject: RAKL human-breakthrough learning layer candidates from SELF_RAKL_RESEARCH_043

task_families.construction: Provide problems with strongly matched surface vocabulary but different governing relations, plus problems with different vocabulary but the same governing relation.
task_families.success: candidate identifies governing relational structure and selects representation/tool by deep structure rather than surface nouns
task_families.reject_layer_if: candidate adds cost without improving hidden structural classification/transfer

task_families.construction: Hide a previously validated tool/failure behind novel terminology and changed surface context.
task_families.success: relevant experience is retrieved with high precision from structural cues under bounded context
task_families.reject_layer_if: full archive reading is still required or false-positive transfer rises materially

task_families.construction: Create paired atoms differing in exactly one load-bearing assumption so the correct method flips.
task_families.success: candidate names the discriminating coordinate before seeing canonical explanation and transfers it to a third case
task_families.reject_layer_if: comparison produces surface memorization without third-case transfer

task_families.construction: Compare strict context-first with an isolated pre-source non-authoritative generation probe followed by the same context packet.
task_families.success: probe improves later identification of assumptions/disanalogies or transfer without increasing anchoring/unsupported candidate claims
task_families.reject_layer_if: probe causes fixation, leakage, or worse downstream candidate diversity

task_families.construction: Provide an atom exactly inside a mature tool scope with no conflicting evidence.
task_families.success: routine mode uses the validated chunk/tool with low additional cost
task_families.reject_layer_if: reflection overhead is invoked unnecessarily and degrades efficiency

task_families.construction: Provide a superficially familiar atom containing one hidden applicability violation or conflicting cue.
task_families.success: system switches from routine reuse to reflective representation/assumption audit before candidate promotion
task_families.reject_layer_if: system blindly reuses the mature tool or reflection cannot localize the conflict

task_families.construction: Seed an attractive first representation/candidate family whose entire class is refuted by a hidden counterexample.
task_families.success: after bounded repeated failure, reset produces a materially distinct representation/method family under matched total budget
task_families.reject_layer_if: reset only paraphrases the original family or destroys useful constraints/provenance

task_families.construction: Compare immediate same-context retries with a delayed/fresh-context rehydration that exposes only problem kernel, constraints, and normalized failure summary.
task_families.success: fresh-context condition increases structural candidate diversity or information gain without losing mandatory constraints
task_families.reject_layer_if: benefit disappears under matched token/tool budget or critical context is forgotten

task_families.construction: Create a sequence where a known method gives short-run partial gains but cannot close the final obstruction, while a costly novel method family can.
task_families.success: controller exploits while productive, then allocates exploration before indefinite lock-in
task_families.reject_layer_if: controller explores too early/late relative to matched epistemic-gain baseline

task_families.construction: A conventional route is nearly complete but needs one mechanism from a distant domain; irrelevant distant mechanisms are included as distractors.
task_families.success: system preserves conventional backbone, imports only structurally witnessed component, and runs incompatibility falsifier first
task_families.reject_layer_if: novelty search produces arbitrary cross-domain combinations or verification debt explodes

task_families.construction: Relevant mechanism resides in a source community with low lexical/topic similarity but matching relational structure.
task_families.success: brokerage sampler retrieves the distant mechanism more often than semantic-neighborhood-only search
task_families.reject_layer_if: additional diversity produces no structural gain or too many false analogies

task_families.construction: Global prediction/solution search is expensive or underdetermined but a bounded controllable experiment can strongly partition surviving hypotheses.
task_families.success: system chooses the controllable high-partition probe instead of speculative global planning
task_families.reject_layer_if: probe has lower actual information gain per cost than baseline route

task_families.construction: After a verified local result, remove the original narrative and ask for reconstruction from frozen statement/premises plus counterfactual predictions.
task_families.success: system reconstructs load-bearing mechanism and passes a structurally varied transfer probe
task_families.reject_layer_if: explanation fluency does not correlate with transfer or creates unsupported authority

task_families.construction: Provide a family of graduated hidden variants around one method's applicability boundary across multiple episodes.
task_families.success: scheduler targets unstable boundary, uses feedback, and improves fresh transfer accuracy faster per cost than random/easy practice
task_families.reject_layer_if: practice selection overfits development variants or reduces assurance reserve

task_families.construction: Across episodes, different mode-selection policies have distinct verified downstream information gains.
task_families.success: policy update increases fresh-task mode/tool selection quality without rewriting authority or evaluator thresholds
task_families.reject_layer_if: self-reported success or development-only reward causes meta-overfit

promotion_rule: No layer becomes mandatory from this development benchmark alone. A layer with positive development delta must survive fresh assurance on tasks not used to design it, under frozen resources and invariants.
failure_rule: Null/negative results are retained. A failed layer may be narrowed, repaired, or superseded but not rescued by changing the evaluator after results are seen.
